name: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

evidence.summary: USST says it became a defence-specialty university co-built by SASTIND and the Shanghai government in July 2016, and that it has built a system of military-industry research qualifications centred on the ‘three military-industry certificates’ (军工三证).
It says SASTIND approved three of its fields, optics, energy and control, as defence-specialty disciplines.
